query:
INSERT INTO moment_carries (moment_id, from_id, to_id, at)
             SELECT m.id, ?, ?, ? FROM moments m
              WHERE m.artifact_id = ? AND m.done_at IS NULL
                AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM moments w
                                 WHERE w.artifact_id = ?
                                   AND w.kind = m.kind
                                   AND w.at IS m.at
                                   AND w.rule IS m.rule
                                   AND w.done_at IS NULL)
